question: Average score of a batsman in 10 innings is 32. How many runs must he score in the 11th innings to raise his average to 34?
solution:
Here is the solution to the given question, formatted exactly as per the specified rules: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

New total runs required = New average × Total innings = 34 × 11 = 374.

Current total runs = Old average × Old innings = 32 × 10 = 320.

Runs needed in 11th innings = New total − Current total = 374 − 320 = 54.

**∴ Answer = 54**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average after 10 innings = 32

New average after 11 innings = 34

**Formula used:**

New total runs = New average × Total innings

Runs in 11th innings = New total − Current total

 Current total = 320 New total = 374 
• Difference = 54 

**Calculations:**

New total runs = 34 × 11 = 374

⇒ Runs in 11th innings = 374 − 320 = 54

**∴ The correct answer is 54.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Formula

Average = Total sum ÷ Number of items

Effect of Adding a New Value

Adding a new value changes the average based on how it compares to the previous average.

Weighted Average

When combining two groups, weighted average = (Sum of weighted values) ÷ Total weights.

Deviation Method

Change in average = (Difference in total sum) ÷ Total number of items.
